A '''Jedi Master''' piloted a [[Unidentified Jedi Master's Defender-class light corvette|''Defender''-class light corvette]] while leading a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] border patrol during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], but the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by a [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] [[Battle of Mugaar|ambush]] in the [[Mugaar system/Legends|Mugaar system]].
